preconditions.description: The duration of charging (a) and the duration of shooting (b) are between 1 and 1000 seconds.
The coordinates of points A and B are within the range [-10000, 10000].
The number of trenches (n) is between 1 and 1000.
The coordinates of the ends of each trench are within the range [-10000, 10000].

preconditions.expression: all((x1 == x2) or (y1 == y2) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: Each trench is either vertical or horizontal.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x1 - x2) <= b and abs(y1 - y2) <= b for x1, y1, x2, y2 in trenches)
preconditions.description: The length of any trench does not exceed b numerically.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating it's impossible to reach point B) or a non-negative number representing the minimum time required.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or return_value <= abs(Ax - Bx) + abs(Ay - By)
postconditions.description: The minimum time required is at most the Manhattan distance between points A and B.
